## Custom Prices

Path: `/custom-prices`
The Custom Prices resource allows Customer specific Product Prices to be created and updated.

<a href="#ProductPriceModel"><b>Custom Price Model</b></a>

<a id="post-custom-prices"></a>
### POST /custom-prices
+ Method will create new Customer specific prices for specified products.

Request body:

```json
{
  "CustomPrices": [
    {
      "CustomerID": "201a76af-9da8-4cb0-ab85-5570f36edff6",
      "ProductSKU": "Screws-SKU - 001",
      "Price": 1.1
    }
  ]
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Errors": []
}
```

<a id="put-custom-prices"></a>
### PUT /custom-prices
+ Method will update Production BOM for specified product.

Request body:

```json
{
  "CustomPrices": [
    {
      "CustomerID": "201a76af-9da8-4cb0-ab85-5570f36edff6",
      "ProductSKU": "Screws-SKU - 001",
      "Price": 1.1
    }
  ]
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Errors": []
}
```

<a id="delete-custom-prices"></a>
### DELETE /custom-prices?ProductID={ProductID}&CustomerID={CustomerID}
+ Method will delete specified Production BOM of specified product.

Parameters:
- `ProductID` (required, guid): Identifier of the Product whose Custom Price will be deleted
- `CustomerID` (required, guid): Identifier of a Customer whose Custom Price will be deleted

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Success": true
}
```

<a id="get-reference-deals"></a>
### GET /reference/deals?ID={ID}&Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Search={Search}

Parameters:
- `ID` (optional): Returns detailed info of a particular Product Deal
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 25 (Default: 25)

## Product Discounts

Path: `/reference/discount`
Define Discount Rules

### Available Fields for Product Discount Rule <a id="ProductDiscountRuleModel"></a>
| Property          | Type      | Length| Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ID`               | Guid      |       | Yes      |                       |
| `Name`              | String      |   128    | Yes      |      Deal Name        |
| `IsActive`          | Bool    |     | Yes      |                        |
| `Type`             | String    |       |    Yes       | Simple, QuantityBased, FreeShipping |
|`DiscountLines`|<a href="#DiscountLineModel"><b>[] Discount Line Model</b></a>||||

### Available Fields for Discount Line Model <a id="DiscountLineModel"></a>
| Property          | Type      | Length| Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ID`               | Guid      |       | Yes      |                       |
| `MinValue`         | Decimal      |       |       | Applicable only when Product Discount Rule Type = QuantityBase and only for the first item in the list. Subsequent items MinValue is being calculated as previous item MaxValue + 0.0001.|
| `MaxValue`          | Decimal    |     |       | Applicable only when Product Discount Rule Type = QuantityBase |
| `DiscountType`     | String    |       |           | DiscountAmount, DiscountPercent, MarkupAmount, MarkupPercent, PriceOverride, FlatAmount, FreeShipping |
| `Amount`          | Decimal    |     | Yes*      |                        |
| `OrderExceeds`          | Decimal    |     | Yes*      | Required when DiscountType = FreeShipping      |

<a id="get-reference-discount"></a>

- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 25 (Default: 25)

## Ship Zones

Path: `/reference/shipZones`
Define shipping zones to determine customer's shipping fees

### Available Fields for Shipping Zone <a id="ShippingZoneModel"></a>
| Property          | Type      | Length| Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ZoneID`               | Guid      |       | Yes      |                       |
| `Name`              | String      |  128     | Yes      |              |
| `IsRestZone`        | Bool    |     | Yes      |                        |
| `PricesInclTax`        | Bool    |     | Yes      |                        |
| `Negative`        | Bool    |     | Yes      |                        |
| `DefaultShippingCost`        | Decimal    |     | Yes      |                        |
| `ShortDesc`        | Bool    |     |       |       Readonly                 |
| `TaxRuleID`        | Guid    |     | Yes*      |                        |
| `TaxRuleName`        | String    |  255   | Yes*      |                        |
|`AppliesTo`|<a href="#ShipZoneAppliesToModel"><b>[] Applies To Model</b></a>||||
|`Conditions`|<a href="#ShipZoneConditionsModel"><b>[] Condition Model</b></a>||||

### Available Fields for Applies To Model <a id="ShipZoneAppliesToModel"></a>
| Property          | Type      | Length| Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ID`               | Guid      |       | Yes      |                       |
| `Country2`         | String      |       |       |  US, SO, NG etc.       |
| `StateID`          | Int    |     |       |                        |
| `StateName`         | String    |       |           | AL, LA, CA etc. |
| `PostCodeFrom`    | String    |  100   |       |                        |
| `PostCodeTo`    | String    |  100   |       |                        |
| `PostCodesList`    | String    |     |       |                        |
| `ShippingRate`    | Decimal    |     |    Yes   |                        |

### Available Fields for Condition Model <a id="ShipZoneConditionModel"></a>
| Property          | Type      | Length| Required  | Notes                 |
|:------------------|-----------|-------|-----------|-----------------------|
| `ZoneConditionID`               | Guid      |       | Yes      |                       |
| `MinValue`    | Decimal    |     |       |                        |
| `MaxValue`    | Decimal    |     |       |                        |
| `ShippingCost`    | Decimal    |     |    Yes   |                        |
| `ConditionType`   | String    |       |    Yes       | Price, Weight |
| `ConditionDescription`    | String    |  128   |       |                        |
